notes.title: Steam Trading Cards come to Mary Skelter: Nightmares!
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

Hope you're all still enjoying Mary Skelter: Nightmares:)

I'm very pleased to say that Steam Trading Cards are now available in Mary Skelter.
Happy Collecting :)

notes.title: Goth anime dungeon crawl Mary Skelter: Nightmares is out now
notes.content:
Idea Factory’s Wizardry/Etrian Odyssey-esque dungeon crawl Mary Skelter: Nightmares did well enough for itself over on the Vita, and made the jump to PC today. Before you go running for the hills, look up there at all those stats and bars and colours! It’s anime excess bleeding into the interface itself, and I wouldn’t have it any other way. Judging by the trailer below, it should help pass the dungeon-crawl void shape in my heart until Nippon Ichi’s Labyrinth of Refrain arrives.

(more…)
